In this episode: What to check before you leave
What to write on the noteboard
How to read the countdown clock
What to do when an item rattles you
Before you leave: Photo ID: government-issued, unexpired, exact registration name
No new material; replay the anti-patterns if anything
Arrive early: late past the window forfeits the fee
Phone, watch, headphones in the locker; accept the NDA
The noteboard: Ask if you may write before the clock starts
Constraint words → component → remove the root → would the guide pick it?
Strike these → use these: stop_reason, hook, error category, escalation triggers
Left panel changes → read it again · unknown flag → strike it
Item formats: Multiple response: read how many to pick first
Dropdown statements: each one is its own item
No throwaway options: judge each statement alone
No domain labels: the left-column scenario is your context
When an item rattles you: Best answer, flag it, move on
Three hard in a row: one breath, then read the last line first
Behind at a checkpoint: past 2 minutes, answer and flag
The last ten minutes: Change an answer only for a reason in the stem
